MAIN_PROGRESS_DAMAGE = 'damage' MAIN_PROGRESS_SERIES = 'battlesSeries'
ADD_PROGRESS_DAMAGE = 'damageAdv' ADD_PROGRESS_SPOTTED = 'spotNumberAdv' ADD_PROGRESS_SERIES = 'battlesSeriesAdv'
def onInit(eventType, eventData, quest, processor): for event in events.iterkeys(): processor.subscribe(event, quest) return True
def onFinishBattle(eventType, eventData, quest, processor): questProgress = quest_progress.BaseQuestProgress(quest.config, processor.getQuestProgress(quest.progressID))
brfilter = filter.BattleResultsFilter(eventData) myHealth = brfilter.getMyHP()
questProgress.getProgress(MAIN_PROGRESS_DAMAGE).setGoal(myHealth * questProgress.getProgress(MAIN_PROGRESS_DAMAGE).getParam("vehicleHealthFactor")) questProgress.getProgress(ADD_PROGRESS_DAMAGE).setGoal(myHealth * questProgress.getProgress(ADD_PROGRESS_DAMAGE).getParam("vehicleHealthFactor"))
damageRes = questProgress.increaseUntilComplete(MAIN_PROGRESS_DAMAGE, eventData['avatarResults']['damageDealt']) damageResAdd = questProgress.increaseUntilComplete(ADD_PROGRESS_DAMAGE, eventData['avatarResults']['damageDealt']) spottedResAdd = questProgress.increaseUntilComplete(ADD_PROGRESS_SPOTTED, eventData['avatarResults']['spotted'])
questProgress.increaseEveryProgress(MAIN_PROGRESS_SERIES, damageRes) questProgress.increaseEveryProgress(ADD_PROGRESS_SERIES, damageResAdd and spottedResAdd)
eventData['results'].update(processor.checkComplete(questProgress, quest.progressID)) processor.setQuestProgress(quest.progressID, questProgress.save())
events = { QUEST_EVENT_TYPE.INIT: onInit, QUEST_EVENT_TYPE.FINISH_BATTLE: onFinishBattle, }
def quest(eventType, eventData, quest, processor): LOG('QUEST EVENT:', eventType, quest.id) return events.get(eventType, lambda *args: False)(eventType, eventData, quest, processor)
